name: next-steps-pane
description: A side pane that gathers the next steps Claude suggests into a tree you can click to run or dismiss.

extractor.title: How to find next steps
extractor.description: heuristic: read headings, lists and offers in each reply (free, instant). model: ask Haiku to pull them out (smarter, costs a small call per turn; falls back to heuristic).

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when new steps arrive
autoOpen.description: Opens the pane beside the transcript the first time steps are found, unless you closed it.

scanToolOutput.title: Read Bash output and task lists too
scanToolOutput.description: Adds hints like "run `npm audit fix`" from Bash output, and open todo/task items.
